name: The Omega Experience
desc:
The Omega Experience
_________________________

👋 Welcome to The Omega Experience! This facility holds creatures and objects beyond scientific reasoning in an attempt to further our knowledge of their purpose and how we can keep humanity safe from them!

From purchasing game passes from The Omega Experience you will be compensated in future game(s) in the form of token equivalent. All game pass purchases support development so that we can produce our creative ideas.

scripts.title: ToxHub Script
scripts.features:
I had some old scripts meant for this game, so I finally packed them into a UI. Since the scripts are quite outdated (made 1-2 years ago, should all still work though because the developers are lazy shits) and this is my first time actually using a UI Library, do not expect the best experience. I might rewrite it later depending on how it's received (aka if I feel like it).
